### The Revelation of God’s Grace
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/revelation-of-gods-grace
Passage: Titus 2:11
Points:
- Cretan culture was steeped in deceit rooted in corrupt pagan mythology.
- Christian virtues are the fruit of genuine faith rather than the starting requirement for redemption.
- The appearance of God's saving grace provides both the motive and the power for holy living.
- Salvation for all people signifies redemption extended across every nation and social boundary, not universalism.
- Continual gratitude for God's repeated forgiveness stirs believers to pursue personal holiness.

### God’s Grace and Holiness
Author: Charles F. Stanley
Site: In Touch Ministries
URL: https://www.intouch.org/read/daily-devotions/gods-grace-and-holiness
Passage: Titus 2:11-12
Points:
- The gospel brings joyful news that saving grace has appeared openly to all people.
- Spiritual power does not guarantee effortless transformation, as grace involves discipline and learning.
- Grace functions like an attentive schoolteacher, training believers to reject worldly passions.
- Pursuing an upright, sensible, and godly life is achievable only through God's enabling grace.
- Patient, ongoing progress in holiness honors God's grace just as much as sudden conversion.
